vacancy.songTitle: I Will Follow You into the Dark
vacancy.linePrev: If Heaven and Hell decide that they both are satisfied
vacancy.line: Illuminate the "no"s on their vacancy signs
vacancy.lineNext: If there's no one beside you when your soul embarks
